title: Ravens DC Anthony Weaver: Tyler Shough reminds me of "a poor-man's Josh Allen"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ravens DC Anthony Weaver: Tyler Shough reminds me of "a poor-man's Josh Allen"
sources.description: Josh Allen's skills were on display in Buffalo's win over the Lions on Thursday night and his performance was the latest reason why any quarterback should be excited about being compared to the Bills star.
